textbookText: > Added layer: the 150 MCQs above are kept intact. Below are the highest-yield > **exam traps**, **formula cheats**, **mnemonics**, and **boundary cards** > compiled from standard Grade-11/NEB-level resources so each MCQ type has a > one-line defense.

| # | Trap | Defense | |---|------|---------| | 1 | Using °C instead of K in gas laws / PVT equations | **EVERY** gas law needs absolute T (K): T(K) = °C + 273.15. A catastrophic, recurring error. | | 2 | Inverting Graham's Law ratio | r₁/r₂ = √(M₂/M₁): the **lighter** gas (smaller M) is **faster**. Heavy-gas-faster is the classic flip. | | 3 | Mixing units (cm vs m) in formulas | Convert everything to SI before substituting; answer-check dimensions at the end. | | 4 | Forgetting latent heat in steam burns | Steam at 100°C burns worse than water at 100°C: it **releases ~2260 kJ/kg** on condensing first. | | 5 | Mirror sign convention slips | Cartesian convention: distances against incident light are **negative**; concave f < 0, convex f > 0. f = R/2 always. | | 6 | m = −v/u sign misread | Negative magnification = **real, inverted** image; positive = virtual, erect. | | 7 | Precision vs accuracy confusion | Accuracy = closeness to TRUE value; Precision = closeness to EACH OTHER. “Cluster far from target” = precise but not accurate. | | 8 | Significant-figures rounding rule | +/−: round to least DECIMAL PLACES. ×/÷: round to least SIGNIFICANT FIGURES. | | 9 | Dimensional analysis overuse | It CANNOT give dimensionless constants (½, 2π) nor relations with +,−, sin, log, exp. | | 10 | Work as F·d with the wrong angle | Work = Fd cosθ with θ between **force and displacement**; 90° ⇒ W = 0. |
